deleteConfirm: Delete cluster "{name}"? Its kubeconfig will be removed from Kubron.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.textHint: The contents will be stored in the Kubron directory, readable only by you.
dialog.teamHint: The cluster belongs to this team; its members get access according to their roles.
dialog.noAdminTeams: You are not an administrator of any team, so you cannot add clusters. Ask an organization administrator.
dialog.inClusterHint: Adds the cluster the Kubron server itself runs in. Access uses the server's ServiceAccount, so everyone with a role in the team gets its permissions.
dialog.argoUrlHint: Published address of Argo CD (for example, an Ingress). If set, Kubron opens it instead of forwarding a port. Leave empty to open Argo CD through the cluster API.
dialog.argoUrlInvalid: Enter an http or https address without credentials, query or fragment.
dialog.sharedAccountOn: Everyone in the team connects with one account. A cluster administrator signs in once when connecting; other members are asked to contact the administrator.
dialog.sharedAccountOff: Each user signs in to the cluster with their own account.

edit.textWarning: The text contains the cluster credentials. Do not show your screen to others.
edit.secretHidden: Secrets are hidden and will be kept as they are. To change one, replace the placeholder with a new value.
edit.stateFile: Will be replaced with the selected file
edit.stateDirty: Edited manually. Saved when you click “Save”
edit.accountChangeWarning: Saved sign-ins of this cluster will be forgotten and everyone will have to sign in again.
edit.accountResetDone: The shared sign-in is forgotten. The next connection will ask a cluster administrator to sign in.

appearance.prodHint: Production cluster: while it is open, a red line is shown in the app header so it cannot be mistaken for another one.

connection.namespaceInvalid: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens only; at most 63 characters.
connection.namespaceAuto: Selected automatically when connecting to the cluster.

accessRevoked: You no longer have access to cluster "{name}". Its terminals, log streams and port-forwards were closed.
